topic: Checking a third-party GitHub repo's license & maintainers before vendoring

messages.text: Can someone confirm the license and current maintainers for the GitHub repo loom/widget-lib before we vendor it into our codebase? Priya needs a definitive answer today.
Is that the same widget-lib we used in the legacy dashboard? There were two similarly named repos.
If it's MIT we're probably fine to vendor; GPL-3 would be a blocker. Whoever checks, please list the license file path and the org/people listed as maintainers.
I'll check the org maintainers list and post links.
Do you mean loom/widget-lib (TypeScript) or loom/widget-lib-js? They have slightly different owners.
Found a packument entry that might list the publisher; saving it here for reference.
Hey — Priya asked the team to confirm loom/widget-lib's license. Can you pull the repo metadata (license, primary language, maintainers) when you have a moment?
I couldn't find a LICENSE in the repo mirror; it might live in a monorepo root. Will keep digging.
Jamal, could you check npm/packument and GH owners for that package? Security wants an explicit maintainer list.
Adding a note: check /LICENSE and the root package.json for declared authors.
Thanks — if someone can confirm by EOD that'd be great. We're trying to avoid a last-minute license mismatch.
On it — I'll fetch the npm packument and paste the author/version details here.
I can take it after lunch unless @you are able to run a quick check now and post what you find.
Also pinged @priya_p to see if she remembers which variant we used months ago.
I'll scan the repo and check contributors + package.json authors. Will report back with links.
